critical_code_review_comments: v25_suite.py is 1116 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into v25_must_have.py (sync/sites/hardware/disputes/suppliers/exceptions), v25_should_have.py (kiosk/cfd/substitute/recovery/station/margin), and v25_tier.py (ash-pro/profit/twin/shift/marketing/pricing/subs/gift/recipes/predictive/waste/guest/concierge/reputation/franchise/benchmark/warehouse/fraud) for maintainability.

Every authenticated endpoint repeats 'from routes.auth import get_current_user' + role-check pattern. Extract a dependency decorator (e.g. require_role('owner','manager')) to remove the ~50 duplicated 4-line blocks (DRY).
ash_plan inserts a new plan to db.ash_plans on every GET — over time this collection will grow unboundedly. Add a TTL index or de-dupe by date so repeated dashboard polls don't blow up storage.

gift_card redeem uses $inc on amount without optimistic concurrency. Two concurrent redeems on the same card can over-redeem past 0 because the balance check is read-before-write non-atomic. Use findOneAndUpdate with the balance condition in the filter.
hardware_heartbeat has no auth at all (intentional for device pings?) — anyone with the URL can mark devices online/offline. Recommend a shared device-secret header or HMAC.

_llm_json swallows exceptions into {'_error': ...}; concierge/marketing/auto silently degrade. Acceptable but the client (e.g. /concierge UI) should distinguish degraded mode and show a banner; currently it just shows empty reply.

POS customer dropdown uses a native HTML <select> which prevents custom search/typeahead. Consider migrating to the shadcn Select component for a11y + searchability, especially when customer list grows (>10 entries).

Recipe upsert pushes computedCost back to products.cost — make sure this is idempotent if recipes/upsert is replayed; current code overwrites unconditionally which is fine but should log the prior cost for audit/rollback.
